ui.recovery.approval.setting_auto.role: in-flight label on the pressed approval-policy link
ui.recovery.approval.setting_auto.note: Replaces 'Set auto for this session' / 'Set auto for all sessions' while the change is being saved. 'auto' is the approval mode that runs tools without asking.

ui.recovery.approval.default_done.role: confirmation label on a finished link-button, with a check mark
ui.recovery.approval.default_done.note: Shown in place of 'Set auto for all sessions' after the press saved auto as the DEFAULT. Conversations with their own choice keep it, so this must not claim every session is now auto.

ui.recovery.approval.session_done.role: confirmation label on a finished link-button, with a check mark
ui.recovery.approval.session_done.note: Shown in place of 'Set auto for this session' after the change was saved.

ui.recovery.approval.answer_hint.note: Follows the confirmation that auto was set. Setting auto does not answer the pending request; this names the buttons that do (Approve / Deny).

ui.recovery.composer.no_provider.role: status line directly under the message box, beside a 'Connect a provider' button
ui.recovery.composer.no_provider.note: Always visible while nothing is connected. Says why Send will not work before the user presses it.

ui.recovery.composer.no_model.role: status line directly under the message box, beside a 'Choose a model' button
ui.recovery.composer.no_model.note: A provider is connected but no model is set as the default.

ui.recovery.composer.local_not_default.role: status line under the message box

placeholders.brand: local model app name, e.g. Ollama

ui.recovery.composer.local_not_default.note: The conversation's chosen model runs on this local app, but the app is not yet the default for chats, so Send is refused. Shown next to the button 'Use {brand} for chats'.

ui.recovery.composer.offline.role: status line under the message box, beside a 'Reconnect' button
ui.recovery.composer.offline.note: Local Operator is the product name; keep it untranslated. The background service is the local process the app talks to.

ui.recovery.send.connect_provider.note: Opens the dialog for connecting a model provider.

ui.recovery.send.choose_model.note: Opens the provider dialog where the default model is chosen.

ui.recovery.send.reconnecting.note: Shown while the reconnect press is running.

ui.recovery.send.still_offline.role: status text after a reconnect press that did not work

placeholders.time: a clock time with seconds, already localized

ui.recovery.send.still_offline.note: Changes on every press (the time has seconds), so the user can see each press ran.

ui.recovery.send.failed_no_provider.role: error sentence on a failed message row
ui.recovery.send.failed_no_provider.note: Shown under a message that failed because no model provider is configured. Next to a 'Connect a provider' button; once connected, the row offers 'Send again'.

ui.recovery.send.failed_no_model.role: error sentence on a failed message row
ui.recovery.send.failed_no_model.note: Shown under a message that failed because no model is selected for the conversation. Next to a 'Choose a model' button.

ui.recovery.send.use_local_failed.note: The press 'Use {brand} for chats' could not save the default. 'model picker' is the composer's model chooser.

ui.recovery.local.intro.note: First line of the panel for a local model app (Ollama, LM Studio). No subject: the panel title names the app.

placeholders.brand: local model app name, e.g. Ollama or LM Studio

ui.recovery.local.checking.note: Shown while the app contacts the local model server.

placeholders.count: number of models the server lists

ui.recovery.local.running_with_models.note: Use the language's own plural categories.

ui.recovery.local.use_for_chats.note: Makes this local app the default model provider for new chats.

ui.recovery.local.using_for_chats.note: Replaces 'Use {brand} for chats' while the setting is saved.

ui.recovery.local.in_use.role: success receipt with a check mark

placeholders.model: model id such as qwen3:8b; keep verbatim

ui.recovery.local.in_use.note: States that chats now run on this app and which model. ' · ' is a separator; keep it.

ui.recovery.local.empty_listing_ollama.role: helper text above a copyable terminal command
ui.recovery.local.empty_listing_ollama.note: Ollama is running but listed no models. The list can be stale, so this is a hint, not an error. The command follows (ollama pull …).

ui.recovery.local.empty_listing_other.note: The local app is running but listed no models; the list can be stale.

ui.recovery.local.not_running_title.note: Nothing answered at the default address.

placeholders.address: a URL such as http://localhost:11434/v1; keep verbatim

ui.recovery.local.not_running_body.note: The app cannot tell 'not installed' from 'not started', so the text gives both next steps.

ui.recovery.local.download.role: button that opens the download page in the browser

ui.recovery.local.start_ollama.role: helper text above a copyable command

ui.recovery.local.no_answer_title.note: The user set a custom address and nothing answered there.

placeholders.status: an HTTP status number such as 404

ui.recovery.local.wrong_server_title.note: A program answered at the address but did not serve the model list.

ui.recovery.local.no_address_title.note: No server address (base URL) is configured, so nothing can be checked.

ui.recovery.local.no_address_body.note: Next step for a provider with no server address. 'check again' matches the 'Check again' button.

ui.recovery.local.check_failed_title.note: The check itself failed inside Local Operator; says nothing about whether the app is running.

ui.recovery.local.check_failed_body.note: 'Local Operator' is the product name; keep it in Latin script.

ui.recovery.local.checked_at.role: small receipt beside the Check again button

placeholders.time: a clock time with seconds, already localized

ui.recovery.local.checked_at.note: Changes on every check, so each press visibly lands.

ui.recovery.local.still_not_found.role: small receipt beside the Check again button after a repeated failed check

placeholders.time: a clock time with seconds, already localized

ui.recovery.local.still_not_found.note: Shown from the second failed check on.

ui.recovery.local.same_result.role: receipt beside the Check again button
ui.recovery.local.same_result.note: Shown on a repeat check that found the same non-ready answer where something WAS found (e.g. another program on the port). ' · ' is a separator; keep it.

ui.recovery.local.copy.note: Copies the command to the clipboard.

ui.recovery.local.alternative_body.role: helper text above the hosted-alternative button
ui.recovery.local.alternative_body.note: Radient is a product name; keep it untranslated.

ui.recovery.local.use_radient.note: Opens the Radient sign-in. Radient is a product name.
